notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.103

• Updates download about 15 times faster: DuckOS fetches them over many connections at once (from the next update on).
• 4G and 5G: the phone may now use them (it was set to 2G/3G only, so it sat on 2G).
• Face unlock does everything by itself: no swiping up after your face on the lock screen, and no "Confirm" after your face in DuckPay, App Lock, DuckWallet, Passwords and passkeys.
• DuckPay: the Face ID tile is gone. While it looks for your face, DuckOS's own ring turns above "Pay with Face".
• Text messages in DuckCloud, end-to-end encrypted: your texts go up sealed, so DuckCloud can't read them, and you can send texts from DuckCloud on the web through your phone. Turn it off in DuckCloud › Text messages.
• End-to-end encryption needs no setup any more: your phone makes the key itself. To open your messages on the web, scan the code it shows with your phone (Settings › DuckConnections › Scan, or the Camera) and confirm it's you.
